movie.title: Alpha
movie.overview: When Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, discovers the dark truth about her family and her stolen childhood, she teams up with her long lost sister to take down her creator and his illicit military program.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A highly trained super-soldier assassin teams up with her long-lost sister to destroy the rogue military commander who stole her childhood.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Raised in total isolation by a rogue military commander, Sita was engineered to be the ultimate weapon. Her world fractures when she uncovers horrific truths about her stolen past and original family. Driven by vengeance and a desire for freedom, she joins forces with her long-lost sister to shatter her creator's network. Together, the duo embarks on a high-stakes mission to dismantle his illicit super-soldier program once and for all.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Sita spent her entire life under the strict control of a rogue commander, forged into a lethal, elite assassin through a clandestine military project. Believing her mentor was her savior, she blindly executed missions until a chance encounter reveals evidence of her stolen childhood and true family lineage. Horrified to learn that her life was built on deception and violence, Sita cuts ties with her operative handlers. She seeks out her long-lost sister, who has been living in the shadows and harboring her own secrets about their shared past. Reunited, the sisters form an uneasy but unstoppable alliance bound by shared blood and a mutual desire for justice. Together, they navigate lethal ops, dodging elite hit squads sent by their former master to silence them. As they breach the commander's heavily fortified headquarters, Sita must confront the man who raised her and face the physical toll of her engineered abilities. In a explosive final showdown, the sisters dismantle the illicit program from the inside, reclaiming their autonomy and ensuring no other children fall victim to the enterprise.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Alpha is a high-octane action thriller that explores the bonds of sisterhood amidst the dark underbelly of black-ops warfare. Sita, a lethal assassin engineered from childhood by a rogue commander, leads a life of absolute precision and isolation. When a routine mission uncovers terrifying clues about her real family and stolen past, Sita turns against the only authority she has ever known. Joining forces with her long-lost sister, Sita embarks on a dangerous journey to expose her creator's illegal super-soldier program, delivering an adrenaline-fueled narrative packed with intense combat, dramatic betrayals, and ultimate redemption.

story_structure.climax: Sita and her sister launch a high-stakes direct confrontation against the rogue commander to destroy the super-soldier program once and for all.
story_structure.conflict: Sita uncovers dark truths about her stolen childhood and her family, prompting her to rebel against her creator and his illicit military program.
story_structure.resolution: With her creator defeated and the military program dismantled, Sita and her sister begin rebuilding their lives and reclaiming the freedom denied to them.
story_structure.introduction: Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, carries out missions without knowing her true origins.
story_structure.risingAction: Reuniting with her long-lost sister, Sita joins forces to infiltrate the operative network, overcome deadly adversaries, and dismantle the program from within.

faq.answer: Alia Bhatt stars as Sita, the super-soldier assassin, alongside Sharvari who plays her twin sister, Durga.

faq.answer: Bobby Deol plays the central villain, Colonel Fateh Singh Shekhawat, the rogue commander who raised and manipulated Sita.

faq.answer: The film was directed by Shiv Rawail and produced by Aditya Chopra under Yash Raj Films.
